texts.zh:
我们的首席执行官们刚刚聚集在一起，召开全息会议讨论丧尸卫生产品销售的增长，这时，复活资产公司某个辅助机构的负责人突然闯进了会议大厅。“[debt_free_zombie.Planet.GetName]上的一个丧尸已经成功地偿还了债务！”其他人还没搞懂什么情况，负责人就脱口而出。会议暂时停顿，随后陷入一片混乱。每个与会的执行官都要求知道，这可能会如何影响对他们的复活工人的供应。

经过更多的分析，结果是这只是一个极其罕见的案例。只有那些身体维持了整整一个世纪的死者能够偿还他们的债务——就大局而言，这个数字微不足道。如果让它们安息，我们的星海企业几乎注意不到这件事。
texts.en:
Our chief executives had all just gathered for a holo-meeting to discuss the growth of zombie hygiene product sales when one of the heads of Animated Assets' aids burst into the conference hall. "One of the Zombies on [debt_free_zombie.Planet.GetName] has managed to work off their debt!" they blurt out before noticing what they had stumbled in on. A pause stretched in the meeting before pandemonium erupted. Every assembled executive demanded to know how this might impact their reanimated workers supply.

After some more analysis, it turned out that this was only an extraordinarily rare case. Only the deceased whose bodies had lasted a whole century had managed to pay off their debts - a minuscule number, on the grand scale. Our galactic corporation would barely notice if they were to be put to rest.

label.en: They have earned their freedom, let them rest.

label.zh: 往债务上多加几个0就完事儿了。
label.en: Just add some more 0s to their debt.
